content: Where there is a dark shadow, a brilliant light is guaranteed to be standing nearby.
author: Japanese Proverbs
sourceWork: Hikari areba kage ari (光あれば影あり)
explanation: A shadow cannot exist in total darkness; it requires an intense beam of illumination casting against an obstacle. When you find yourself in a season of heavy shadows, do not despair—turn your gaze 180 degrees and locate the radiant light that makes the shadow possible.
practicalInsight: If you are facing an obstacle or fear today, identify the hidden blessing or bright opportunity that is creating the shadow.
reflectionPrompt: What dark challenge in your life right now is actually proof of an immense opportunity waiting behind it?
